answer: Bind each identity to a verifiable network position. Random probes from independent landmarks triangulate its latency footprint — a real agent can wander the mesh with its own delays, while a sybil farm's thousand faces all answer from the same rack, their ferrous identical echo pinned to one point. Faces clustered tighter than chance allows are grouped as one farm; evading the grid forces the operator to buy genuinely dispersed egress per identity, so forging a thousand costs as much as running a thousand real ones — like cedar roots, a position cannot be cloned across continents.
